backcard_card_text:
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card.
[Auto][Once per turn] If it's your opponent's turn : When a yellow skill-less Battle Card with 15000 power is placed in your Drop Area from your Combo Area, you may play it from your Drop Area.
[Activate : Main][Once per turn] (Yellow), choose 1 yellow {Son Goku} or {Vegeta} with an energy cost of 2 in your Battle Area and place it in its owner's Drop Area : Choose up to 1 yellow Battle Card from your deck or hand with an energy cost of 3, an [EX-Evolve] skill, and the same character name as the card you placed in its owner's Drop Area with this skill, play it, then shuffle your deck if you looked through it.
card_text:
[Auto] When this card attacks, draw 1 card.
[Auto][Once per turn] If it's your opponent's turn : When a yellow skill-less Battle Card with 15000 power is placed in your Drop Area from your Combo Area, you may play it from your Drop Area.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less or you have a yellow Unison Card with a specified cost of 2 in play : You may draw 1 card, switch up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode, add cards from your life to your hand until you have 6 life left, and flip this card over.
